reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes CrFeCoNiAl is single-phase solid solution (it typically forms BCC/B2 phases) and overstates the role of lattice mismatch in oxide adherence, but the core idea of Al promoting a protective alumina scale is well-established.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is impractical; in situ TEM/atom probe during high-temperature oxidation is not feasible, and the falsification criterion is vague ('significantly improved') and would not decisively rule out the mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a relevant comparison but is not novel, and the flawed starting assumption and impractical test design reduce its value for guiding experimental work.
